fields.statement: At 5c8ba463b (RHIZA_ROOT/RHIZA_RUN unset, GOTMPDIR outside the repo): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/model-commit-untracked$' passes. The script uses a local bare origin and a fake gh, leaves two orphan change sets plus one held by a live run's worktree, runs rhiza model commit-untracked, and asserts one model branch and one gh pr create per orphan folder. That is 3, because rhiza init's actor folder is a third orphan. It also asserts the held entry stays untracked and on no branch, and that a second run is quiet. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestDaemonCommitsUntracked -v passes (daemonCommitUntracked makes a model/<cs>- branch with one PR per branch, and a second tick ships nothing). Run from a scratch worktree outside ~/code, because inside ~/code the rootguard tripped on the live daemon's usage.live.json. In the diff, daemonCommitUntracked is called from every daemon poll (internal/api/daemon_projects.go:424), behind modelBranchEnabled. Known minor review findings (branch count 3 vs 2, 8-char prefix check) stand, but they do not defeat the acceptance.
